summary: Completed frontend testing of subdomain routing and avatar fixes. All 7 test cases passed: 1) Main domain shows Portal Selector, 2) ?portal=meet routes to AI KARAU Meeting login, 3) ?portal=jobs routes to MedMatch Jobs login (skips Portal Selector), 4) Tutorial page loads correctly, 5) Japanese avatar shows Asian woman, 6) African language avatars (Swahili, Afrikaans, Hausa, Zulu) show African woman, 7) Data Privacy video shows male presenter image.

issues: Video shows 'Video unavailable' error for German tutorial - video file may not exist on server

critical_code_review_comments: Subdomain routing correctly implemented using URL query params (?portal=meet, ?portal=jobs) for preview environment
SubdomainRouter component in App.js properly routes based on subdomain/query param
LANGUAGE_AVATAR_MAPPING correctly maps Japanese (ja) to 'asian' avatar type
African languages (sw, af, ha, zu) correctly mapped to 'african' avatar type
PRESENTER_IMAGES correctly uses '/images/presenter_male.jpeg' for Data Privacy video (03_privacy_matters)
Avatar images use Unsplash URLs with cache-busting version parameter (v=20260218)
